title: OEM batch supply for a pump skid
background: A skid builder needed one model family for twelve machine variants, with identical mounting and wiring on every unit.
requirements: One wiring scheme across all variants.
selection: Two models cover the whole range: the base variant for standard units and the extended-range variant for high-pressure units.
results: Assembly time cut by 30 minutes per unit.
Only two part numbers to stock.
Field replacements match the original batch.
Spare stock kept at two part numbers after the first year.
seoTitle: OEM batch supply for a pump skid — deployment note
seoDescription: OEM batch supply for a pump skid: constraints, models chosen and measurable results. A short deployment note for engineers comparing similar setups.

zh.title: 泵撬块 OEM 批量配套
zh.background: 撬块厂商需要一套型号覆盖 12 种机型，且每台的安装与接线方式必须一致。
requirements: 所有机型共用一种接线方案。
zh.selection: 两个型号覆盖全线：标准机型用基础款，高压机型用扩展量程款。
results: 单台装配时间减少 30 分钟。
现场替换件与原批次一致。
运行一年后备件只需维护两个料号。
zh.seoTitle: 泵撬块 OEM 批量配套：十二机型共用一套方案
zh.seoDescription: 泵撬块批量配套项目记录：十二种机型共用一套接线与安装方案，按周分批交付，替代件可按批次追溯，并记录选定型号、约束条件与装配时间的变化。现场可用。
